utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Hi Grandma! How have you been?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh yes, I remember that! It was quite fun, wasn't it? How have you been since then?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: I've been good, just busy with school and everything. How about you?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, I see! Developing a habit sounds like a good idea. I'll try to keep that in mind.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: That sounds great! What kind of habit are you thinking of starting?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh dear, I misunderstood. I thought you meant to use the app for practice. I'll focus on counting the beats instead.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: No worries, Grandma! Counting beats is a great way to practice too. Let me know if you need any help with the app later.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, a new chord! That sounds exciting. I'm ready to learn, dear.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: I'm so glad you're excited! Let's start with the basics and build up from there. It'll be fun!

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, the G7 chord! I can't wait to try it out. Thank you for teaching me, dear.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: You're welcome, Grandma! I'm sure you'll get the hang of it quickly. Let's give it a try together.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, just two fingers? That seems manageable. I'll give it a try right now.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Great! Let's see how it sounds. If you need any help, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, I see it now. Let me try to place my fingers like that.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: You're doing great, Grandma! Keep going, and let me know if you need any more tips.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Ah, I understand now. Let me try playing it slowly.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: That's the spirit, Grandma! You're picking it up so quickly.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, just the left hand? Thank you for pointing that out, dear.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: You're welcome, Grandma! I'm always here to help you out.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Alright, let's give it a try with the C chord first.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Great choice, Grandma! The C chord is a good starting point.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Thank you for your patience, dear. Let's start with the C chord then.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: No problem at all, Grandma! Let's get started with the C chord.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, I see. Let me try with the G7 chord now.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: That's a great choice too, Grandma! The G7 chord will sound lovely.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Alright, I'll keep my thumb in place. Let's move to the next line together.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Great! You're doing so well, Grandma. Let's try playing it together now.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Got it, back to the C chord for the last measure. Thank you for guiding me through this.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: You're welcome, Grandma! I'm really enjoying this time with you.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Thank you, dear. I'm glad I'm getting the hang of it with your help.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: I'm so proud of you, Grandma! You're really picking it up quickly.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Thank you for the lesson today. I'm looking forward to practicing more.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: I'm excited to see how much you'll improve next time!
